description: This file defines the internal class 'ProxyInterfaceDescription' within the Orleans.CodeGenerator namespace. It models the description of proxy interfaces, including their methods, type parameters, and validation logic for the base class. It is used in code generation for Orleans proxies.

classes.name: ProxyInterfaceDescription
classes.description: Represents a description of a proxy interface, including its methods, type parameters, and validation logic for the base class.

methods.name: GetMethods
methods.description: Retrieves the list of proxy method descriptions, excluding explicit interface implementations.

methods.name: ValidateBaseClass
methods.description: Validates that the base class contains the appropriate InvokeAsync methods with correct signatures.
